original_benchmark.notes: AstaBench (allenai/asta-bench, built on Inspect AI) evaluates 11 families on a test and a validation split. Sizes as upstream evaluates them: litqa2 75+10, paper_finder_litqa2 75+10, arxivdigestables 100+70, paper_finder 267+66, sqa 100+100, discoverybench 239+25, super 45 (Expert/test) + 50 (Auto/validation, capped by upstream sample_limit), ds1000 900+100, core_bench 37+35 (after upstream's filter_out_gpu=True drops 8 test and 10 validation capsules from 45+45), e2e_discovery 40+10, e2e_discovery_hard 40+10; total 1,918 test + 486 validation = 2,404. Upstream ships no Harbor-compatible agent: the asta-bench package provides Inspect solvers only, and the leaderboard agents live in the separate allenai/agent-baselines repository, so supported_agents is None. Parity uses the fork smiky2011/asta-bench@claude-haiku-judges, which adds the `astabench/react` solver and points every LLM judge at anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5.

harbor_adapter.notes: 1,918 test + 436 validation = 2,354 tasks. Per-family test/validation: litqa2-fulltext 75/10, litqa2-fulltext-search 75/10, arxivdigestables-clean 100/70, paper-finder 267/66, sqa 100/100, discoverybench 239/25, super-expert 45/0, ds1000 900/100, core-bench-hard 37/35, e2e-bench 40/10, e2e-bench-hard 40/10. Not adapted: the 50 SUPER 'Auto' samples (upstream super_validation), because their metric scores an execution history the agent can write (see README Notes & Caveats). Two packagings of the same tasks are generated: the Inspect-AI bridge dataset (default) and a standard CLI-agent dataset (--cli). The parity subset (146 tasks: 114 test + 32 validation, all 11 families) is fixed in src/asta_bench/parity_task_ids.txt. PARITY STATUS: the parity experiment for this revision has not been run yet; parity_matching_agents, parity_unmatching_agents and parity_costs will be filled from the new runs. The May 2026 result in parity_experiment.json was measured on an earlier revision and is superseded. The custom agent inspect-solver@0.1.0 (asta_bench.inspect_solver:InspectSolver) runs AstaBench's `astabench/react` Inspect solver inside the task container with --no-score; rewards always come from the Harbor verifier.
